description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 te HORA VERTIKALE, nje nga projektet me moderne dhe ambicioze qe po ndertohen ne Tirane.
Me nje siperfaqe totale prej 93 m², apartamenti ofron nje organizim praktik dhe bashkekohor: sallon ndenjeje me kuzhine te integruar, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe dy ballkone me pamje te hapur.
Projekti ndodhet ne fazat e para te ndertimit, duke e bere nje mundesi shume te mire investimi ne kohe si per rritje vlere, ashtu edhe per sigurine e nje prone cilesore ne qender te qytetit.
Pozicioni ne nje nga katet e larta ofron qetesi, ndricim natyral dhe pamje te gjere mbi Tiranen.
description_en: 1+1 apartment in HORA VERTIKALE, one of the most modern and ambitious projects being built in Tirana. With a total area of ​​93 m², the apartment offers a practical and contemporary organization: living room with integrated kitchen, a bedroom, a bathroom and two balconies with open views. The project is in the first stages of construction, making it a very good opportunity to invest in time both for value growth and for the security of a quality property in the center of the city. The position on one of the high floors offers tranquility, natural lighting and a wide view over Tirana.
